snippet.title: Detective Dotson - Official Chapter 2 Overview Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Get a peek at what's coming in Chapter 2 of Detective Dotson in this latest trailer for the mystery adventure game about an aspiring actor turned detective. In Chapter 2, more family drama ensues as Dotson's mom ends up in jail. Explore a new location in Chapter 2 and don a new disguise as a dog. Detective Dotson: Chapter 2 will be available soon on PC via Steam.
